analysis.title: US Equity Financing Monitor
key_insights: Implied funding rates eased further over the past week amid market weakness.
Short-dated (pre-year-end) funding remains relatively cheap but edged slightly higher w/w.
Year-end funding fell for a third consecutive week. The Dec'26-Mar'27 S&P 500 forward-starting AIR TRF spread is ~74bps, down 3bps w/w.
Longer-dated funding also eased, though 6M+ tenors remain relatively firm in the ~60th+ percentiles.
S&P 500 AIR TRF pricing rose 2bps in Dec'26 and was little changed across the rest of the curve w/w.
S&P 500 AIR TRF volumes totaled ~$85.9Bn (0.5z) over the past week, concentrated in Nov'26, Dec'26, Mar'27, Dec'27 and Dec'28. Open interest fell ~$7.2Bn w/w.
Russell 2000 and Nasdaq 100 AIR TRFs did not trade over the past week.
charts_described: Figure 2 table: S&P 500 AIR TRF Dec'26 bid/ask 34/40 bps, 1w change +2, 4w change -14, OI $134.1Bn, ADV 1w $7,331Mn.
Figure 3 table: curve spreads (mids) Dec'26 to Dec'30 at 52bps.
vol_and_positioning: Dec'26-Mar'27 S&P 500 forward-starting AIR TRF spread ~74bps, down 3bps w/w, third consecutive weekly decline in year-end funding.
S&P 500 AIR TRF open interest totals $377.8Bn, down $7.2Bn w/w. Dec'26 OI is $134.1Bn (-$14.0Bn w/w), Mar'27 $66.9Bn (+$10.5Bn w/w), Dec'27 $47.7Bn.
AIR TRF quotes as spread to EFFR: Dec'26 34/40 bps, Mar'27 61/67, Dec'28 71/77, Dec'30 86/92. Dec'26 is up 2bps w/w and down 14bps over 4 weeks (mid).
Curve spreads (mids): Dec'26 to Dec'28 37bps, Dec'26 to Dec'30 52bps, Dec'26 to Mar'27 27bps.
Weekly S&P 500 AIR TRF ADV is $17,183Mn vs $11,270Mn 1-month ADV.
